sources.title: Z-Image Turbo Image Model | aicreators.tools
sources.snippet: Z-Image-Turbo came out on Nov 27th 2025 and it lets you generate an image from plain language prompts. It's said to follow instructions well. The model comes from a group called Tongyi-MAI which seems is part of Alibaba's AI setup, likely linked to the wider Tongyi model family that started inside Alibaba Cloud. Some info from FAL suggests the tool runs fast, with about a one-second delay ...
